summary: Instance memory management: allocates and wraps instance memory objects from physical RAM, suspends and saves object contents to host memory, restores them on resume via BAR2, and manages the instance address space lifetime.

dtor.what: Returns the internal nv50_instmem struct pointer for cleanup of instance memory resources

fini.what: Sets the instance memory base address to ~0ULL to invalidate the address space

suspend.what: Saves instance object contents to host memory for objects marked as preserve

resume.what: Restores instance objects from host memory then reinitialises BAR2 address space

memory_new.what: Allocates physical RAM from device then wraps it into an instance memory object

evidence.quote: ret = nvkm_ram_get(imem->subdev.device, 0, 1, page, size, true, true, &ram);

memory_wrap.what: Allocates nv50_instobj struct then wraps given RAM into it as an instance memory object

zero.what: Flags whether new instance memory objects should be zeroed on allocation
